industries.name: AI models & labs
industries.def: Builds and sells its own AI models or AI agents as the core product.

industries.name: AI compute & cloud
industries.def: Sells compute, data centers or data infrastructure built for training and running AI models.

industries.name: Semiconductors & hardware
industries.def: Designs or makes chips, photonics, networking silicon or chip-making equipment.

industries.name: Enterprise software
industries.def: Sells software or cloud services to businesses (not primarily security).

industries.name: Cybersecurity & identity
industries.def: Protects networks, endpoints, identities or data; public-safety technology.

industries.name: Quantum computing
industries.def: Builds quantum computers or quantum-specific software as the core product.

industries.name: Consumer internet
industries.def: Apps, social networks, marketplaces and delivery platforms used by consumers.

industries.name: Telecom & wireless
industries.def: Fixed, wireless, fiber or messaging networks and services.

industries.name: Media, entertainment & gaming
industries.def: Film, live events, cinemas, sports media and video games.

industries.name: Payments & spend
industries.def: Moves money: payment processing, cards, cross-border payments, spend management.

industries.name: Digital banking & lending
industries.def: Licensed or partner banks, neobanks and consumer or business lenders.

industries.name: Trading & market infrastructure
industries.def: Exchanges, trading venues, prediction markets and market data for trading.

industries.name: Crypto & digital assets
industries.def: Exchanges, custody and infrastructure for crypto assets as the core business.

industries.name: Insurance & brokerage
industries.def: Insurers, reinsurers and insurance brokers (operating companies, not sidecars).

industries.name: Wealth & asset-management technology
industries.def: Platforms serving advisers, wealth managers and asset managers.

industries.name: Biotech & pharmaceuticals
industries.def: Discovers or develops drugs and therapies.

industries.name: Medical devices
industries.def: Makes medical devices and surgical systems used by clinicians.

industries.name: Life-science tools & biomanufacturing
industries.def: Instruments, cell-therapy manufacturing and research tools sold to drug makers and labs.

industries.name: Health care services
industries.def: Provides care or care management to patients.

industries.name: Health care technology
industries.def: Software, AI diagnostics and pharmacy platforms for health care.

industries.name: Aerospace & defense
industries.def: Defense systems, aircraft and aerospace supply chain.

industries.name: Autonomous vehicles & robotics
industries.def: Self-driving vehicles, humanoid and industrial robots, and the autonomy software for them.

industries.name: Space
industries.def: Satellites, spacecraft and space stations.

industries.name: Transportation & logistics
industries.def: Moves goods or people: freight, barges, helicopters, drone delivery.

industries.name: Industrial manufacturing
industries.def: Makes industrial components and equipment.

industries.name: Business & building services
industries.def: Services to businesses and buildings: alarm monitoring, metering, inspection.

industries.name: Clean energy, storage & batteries
industries.def: Energy storage, battery materials and recycling, renewable generation technology.

industries.name: Oil, gas & drilling
industries.def: Exploration, production, drilling and fuel distribution.

industries.name: Power generation & utilities
industries.def: Owns or operates power plants and grid assets.

industries.name: Mining & metals
industries.def: Finds or mines minerals, metals and coal.

industries.name: Chemicals & advanced materials
industries.def: Makes chemicals, engineered materials, lab-grown diamonds or bio-based ingredients.

industries.name: Retail & e-commerce
industries.def: Sells goods to consumers, online or in stores.

industries.name: Consumer brands & apparel
industries.def: Owns and sells consumer product brands, mostly apparel.

industries.name: Food & beverage
industries.def: Makes or distributes food and beverages.

industries.name: Consumer hardware
industries.def: Consumer electronics and wearables.

industries.name: Hospitality & leisure
industries.def: Hotels, travel and leisure operators.

industries.name: Mobility services
industries.def: Ride-hailing, micromobility and car-sharing.

industries.name: Education
industries.def: Schools, education services and education publishers.

industries.name: Consumer services
industries.def: Services sold to consumers in person: car washes, gyms, pest control, home services.

industries.name: Real estate & homebuilding
industries.def: Owns, develops or builds property.

industries.name: Property technology
industries.def: Software and marketplaces for buying, renting or managing property.

themes.name: AI
themes.def: AI-native: the core product is an AI model or AI system, or the compute, chips or data platforms used to build and run models. Using AI inside another product does not count.

themes.name: Fintech
themes.def: Technology-led financial services: payments, digital banking, lending, trading and insurance distribution built on software.

themes.name: Defense tech
themes.def: Sells to defense or national-security customers as a core market.

themes.name: Climate
themes.def: The core product cuts emissions or enables the energy transition (storage, battery materials, clean power, low-carbon compute).

themes.name: Crypto
themes.def: Crypto assets are the core business.

themes.name: Space
themes.def: Builds or operates hardware in space.

themes.name: Robotics & autonomy
themes.def: Builds robots or autonomous machines (vehicles, drones, humanoids, surgical robots).

themes.name: Quantum
themes.def: Quantum computing, sensing or post-quantum security is the core product.
